newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse stable at higher levels.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse stable at higher levels.

text.p: 1250 GMT - German equities end bourse up generally higher, defying expectations of a lower start to the week amid U.S. interest rate hike jitters. Dealers say 25 basis point hike already discounted in the market. Dollar resilience supports.
* DAX-30 index ends at 3,321.84 points, up 23.60 points.
* DTB DAX future at 3,333 points, up 28.
* Krupp, Thyssen end higher as cooperation talks continue, reports of internal Thyssen analysis showing shre price likely to strengthen helps buoy sentiment.
* Holzmann up, talk of Deutsche-Hochtief share pool.
* Gerresheimer Glas down on lower 96 figures.
